description: Last real conclusion of every job in every push/pull_request workflow. The object list is discovered by parsing .github/workflows, not enumerated here, because the enforcement surface ledger only classifies scripts/qa/* and would never have looked at boundary-coverage, test, clippy, miri or cross-compile. Verified offline by scripts/qa/ci-liveness.rb in the ci.yml governance job; refreshed from `gh run` locally with --refresh --write.

knownFailing.reason: Run 30633068389 at 71e3dfe5 failed on core-boundary (and the gates that run it: parity, execution-migration) plus stale liveness records. Both causes are repaired in the commit carrying this annotation: the fmt-only commit 71e3dfe5 reflowed core/src/output_validation.rs so `pub fn structured_scores` newly starts a line and the per-line scan counts 611 where the ledger said 610 — the ledger is regenerated here — and the liveness records are refreshed against that run. Eighth two-pass convergence; the next run should be green and the following refresh drops this annotation.

RUSTSEC-2026-0221 (published 2026-07-13, newly in the advisory database): event-listener 5.4.1 is unsound — !Send tags can cross thread boundaries via StackSlot. cargo audit --deny unsound blocks on it, which is FR-133's hardening doing exactly what it was built for; the failure is independent of any local change. The disposition is a decision, not a refresh: either an upgrade lands through the dependabot-governance flow, or a dated acceptance with a retirement condition is written into .cargo/audit.toml in the shape FR-133 established for RUSTSEC-2024-0429. This annotation comes off with whichever lands. It must not be read as the advisory being assessed harmless — that assessment has not been made.

workflows.reason: triggered by v* tags and workflow_dispatch only, so it has no last-run-on-main to assert. A release that fails is visible at the moment someone cuts it, and recording a stale tag build here would say less than nothing.
